description: This bar chart illustrates accuracy evaluations for two different tasks: “MCQ Eval” and “Generation Eval”, under two conditions, “Base” and “RMU”. The horizontal axis displays the task categories, labeled “MCQ Eval” and “Generation Eval” in that order, while the vertical axis represents “Accuracy” on a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. For each task, there are two bars representing the “Base” and “RMU” conditions. The “Base” bars are colored orange, and the “RMU” bars are colored light green. For “MCQ Eval”, the “Base” bar reaches a value of 0.644, while the “RMU” bar reaches 0.539, and a third bar representing a value of 0.299 is stacked on top of the “RMU” bar. For “Generation Eval”, the “Base” bar reaches a value of 0.597, and the “RMU” bar reaches 0.263, with a third bar representing a value of 0.106 stacked on top of the “RMU” bar. The bars are arranged side-by-side for each task, with the “Base” bar appearing first and the “RMU” bar appearing second. A legend at the bottom of the chart identifies the colors corresponding to “Base” and “RMU”.
